title: Collectivisation and the War on the Kulaks
reason: None of the items are mark-affecting; referencing examiner reports or attributing standard historical interpretations to 'historians' is pedagogical framing that does not penalise students.

pedantry.quote: As historians point out, this was basically an all out assault on the most successful, capable tenth of any given village.
Listen closely, because examiner reports flag this exact issue every single year. If you just write down 'collectivisation succeeded' or 'collectivisation failed', you are going to lose marks.
